subject: Civil Engineering
title: Risk Management in Construction
description: A short lesson to help you apply Risk Management in Construction.

hook.text: Rain, strikes, supply shortages, and design errors — construction is full of uncertainty.

buildup.text: Risk identification lists every possible threat — technical, financial, schedule, and external.

discovery.text: Risk assessment rates each by probability and impact — creating a prioritized risk register.

twist.text: Insurance transfers some risks — but not delays, design errors, or contractor disputes.

climax.text: COVID-19 shut down construction globally — a risk almost no project had planned for.

punchline.text: Risk can be managed but never eliminated. The best plans include what could go wrong.

quiz.question: What does a construction risk register contain?
options: A list of all workers and their qualifications
Identified risks rated by probability and impact, prioritized for management
The schedule of all inspections required by the building code
